related_questions.question: When should I get the new COVID vaccine?

text_blocks.snippet: It is recommended to get the updated 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine as soon as it is available to you, especially if it has been more than a few months since your last COVID-19 vaccine or infection. This is because protection from COVID-19 vaccines and natural infection decreases over time. The updated vaccines are formulated to target currently circulating strains of the virus, providing the best protection.

list.snippet: Time since last dose or infection: The CDC advises that you should get the updated vaccine even if you recently had COVID-19, but you may consider delaying it a bit.
Circulating strains: The updated vaccines are designed to target the latest COVID-19 variants.
Individual risk factors: People with certain health conditions or who are at higher risk of severe illness from COVID-19 may want to get vaccinated sooner.
